messages:
Ava: hi team, first day! I got an Okta invite but it linked to ava.personal@notwork.com instead of my company email (ava.t@redwood.com). also no 1Password invite and Drive says I dont have access :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Ava! Provisioning started. Snapshot: Okta user created (email mismatch detected), Google Drive share pending, 1Password seat pending.
Marco (IT): hey @Ava, can you paste the link from the Okta invite email? sometimes SSO picks the wrong identity provider when forwarded emails exist.
Ava: the invite link is `https://okta.redwood.com/invite/ABCD-1234` - email preview shows recipient ava.personal@notwork.com when opened from my personal inbox. I did sign up on the hire form with ava.t@redwood.com.
Marco (IT): thanks — looks like the invite was forwarded from your personal address which created a secondary account. Ill merge the accounts and reissue the invite.
Marco (IT): running: `/admin/users/resolve?primary=ava.t@redwood.com&alias=ava.personal@notwork.com` -> job queued (job id: 1f9d3). Also pausing auto-reconcile so 1Password seat doesn't get assigned to alias.
DevOps: note: 1Password mapping uses Google group email; if Okta shows alias that differs, mapping can fail. After merge, trigger a group sync: `POST /internal/syncs/google-groups?force=true&user=ava.t@redwood.com`.
Sam (People Ops): @Marco thanks. I confirmed the hire form had ava.t@redwood.com. Re-sent the official offer email to that address just in case. Also reserving a 1Password seat pending merge.
Marco (IT): merge complete. re-sending Okta invite now and pushing group sync. Invite reissued to ava.t@redwood.com.
Ava: got the new Okta email and logged in — Okta shows device trust setup. But 1Password still not in my inbox.
DevOps: replaying the webhook queue for 1Password for user ava.t@redwood.com. Also manually assigned a hold seat while we confirm group membership.
Security: quick reminder: if you registered passkeys under the alias, we need to clear them and re-register under the primary account after merge. @Ava, do you see any enrolled devices listed in Okta?
Ava: in Okta > Security Devices it lists one "WebAuthn" entry tied to ava.personal@notwork.com. It wont let me remove it.
Marco (IT): I removed the stale WebAuthn device from the alias account and re-provisioned device trust for your primary. Please try registering a passkey now.
Ava: passkey registration worked. I also received the 1Password invite this time and set up my account. Drive shared folder link is visible now.
Sam (People Ops): welcome aboard @Ava! Ill mark the provisioning ticket resolved and follow up with hardware YubiKey shipment.
Onboarding Bot: Provisioning complete: Okta primary account active, passkey registered, Drive access granted, 1Password seat assigned. Auto-close in 1h if no further activity.
Ava: thanks everyone  appreciate the quick help :smile:
